# Skill: Decentralized Model Policy

## Purpose

Apply the community-controlled publication rules for decentralized deployments.

## Rules

- Treat the platform as a resilient social/publication network with community-controlled policy.
- Preserve contributor control of approved content and support contributor-side or distributed storage.
- Store the canonical content hash, version reference, review evidence, and publication event so replicas can verify integrity.
- Do not require one central operator to control routine publication after configured safety checks pass.
- Make moderation, advertising, and discovery policies explicit to each community or deployment.
- Keep paid promotion clearly labeled without turning advertising into hidden identity disclosure.
- Require re-review when an approved version changes; reject hash mismatches.
- Never allow model choice, reputation, payment, or popularity to bypass safety or privacy blocks.

## Output

Return the community policy, hash state, review evidence, publication state, and replication metadata.
